# UI Vault — full catalog

> 1257 entries from 19 sources. Generated by `npm run llms`.

## Sources

### React Bits — https://reactbits.dev
134 free MIT components across text animations, backgrounds, animations and interactive components, with TypeScript/JavaScript and Tailwind/CSS variants per component. Pro tier adds blocks and templates.
License: MIT. Install: npx jsrepo add react-bits/<Component>.
### Motion Primitives — https://motion-primitives.com
~35 minimalist motion components by ibelick, built entirely on Motion (motion.dev). Every component is a copy-paste primitive with a dedicated CLI. Pro adds 50+ premium components and sections.
License: MIT. Install: npx motion-primitives@latest add <name>.
### FancyComponents — https://fancycomponents.dev
~46 fun and weird components recreating effects from award-winning sites — letter swaps, gravity, elastic lines, gooey filters. Fully MIT and open source by danielpetho.
License: MIT. Install: pnpm dlx shadcn add @fancy/<component>.
### NumberFlow — https://number-flow.barvian.me
The animated number (odometer/digit-spin) component. Dependency-free custom element + Web Animations API, reduced-motion aware, SSR friendly. 7.7k GitHub stars.
License: MIT. Install: npm i @number-flow/react.
### Watermelon UI — https://watermelon.sh
Fully open-source shadcn-style library: components, animated micro-interactions, section blocks and 10+ complete dashboards. Free forever for personal and commercial use.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://registry.watermelon.sh/r/<name>.json.
### Aceternity UI — https://ui.aceternity.com
200+ production-ready components and blocks that "look expensive" — parallax heroes, beams, shaders, docks. Free tier covers ~100 components; premium adds 200+ blocks and full templates.
License: Freemium. Install: npx aceternity-ui@latest add <name>.
### shadcn/ui — https://ui.shadcn.com
65 Radix-based primitives — every install vendors the source into your project. Charts via Recharts, tables via TanStack, drawer via Vaul, carousel via Embla. The de-facto foundation most libraries below build on.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add <component>.
### Magic UI — https://magicui.design
76 animated components — animated beams, globes, marquees, device mocks, 18 text animations and 11 backgrounds. Distributed as a shadcn registry; templates are paid, all components are free.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/<component>.
### Animata — https://animata.design
154 published motion components across text, widgets, cards, bento grids, buttons and heroes — every one installable through a shadcn-style registry. The repo documents 198; 44 are still unpublished.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://animata.design/r/<name>.json.
### Animate UI — https://animate-ui.com
154 animated components in your choice of headless flavor — Radix UI, Base UI, Headless UI or native — plus 11 text animations and 14 effect primitives. All Motion-powered, installed via shadcn registry.
License: Free. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @animate-ui/<slug>.
### Launch UI — https://www.launchuicomponents.com
Free section library for marketing pages — navbar, hero, items, logos, FAQ, CTA, pricing, stats and footer blocks, plus button, badge, mockup, screenshot, glow, fade and glass utilities. React 19, Tailwind v4, Radix.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @launchui/<block>.
### Origin UI — https://coss.com/origin
The Origin UI legacy snapshot, preserved MIT inside the COSS monorepo after the rebrand: 599 variants across 31 families. Inputs alone ship 59 variants; buttons 54; selects 51.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://coss.com/origin/r/<family>.json.
### COSS UI — https://coss.com/ui
55 Base-UI-powered components, 2 hooks and 508 registry particles grouped into 54 families — the current-generation component collection from the COSS team, installed through the official @coss shadcn namespace.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @coss/<component>.
### Cult UI — https://cult-ui.com
77 MIT components — dithered and liquid-metal heroes, neumorphic and beam buttons, dynamic islands, macOS docks, 3D carousels, WebGL shaders and pixel typography. Cult Pro is a separate paid product; only the MIT repo set is cataloged.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/<name>.json.
### Kibo UI — https://www.kibo-ui.com
40 niche components no other library ships — Gantt charts, kanban boards, contribution graphs, credit cards, story reels, glimpse link previews, relative-time and Tinder-style decks. Fully client-side, no external services.
License: MIT. Install: npx kibo-ui add <component>.
### Kokonut UI — https://kokonutui.com
116 free MIT components — 27 AI chat/agent pieces (tool approvals, tool calls, diff review, inline citations, voice, checkout) plus inputs, cards, buttons, backgrounds, navigation and text effects. Kokonut UI Pro (heroes, sections, templates) is paid and excluded.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @kokonutui/<name>.
### Arc UI — https://uiarc.dev
121 free components + 22 free blocks — inputs, data-viz charts, disclosure, feedback, and auth/marketing blocks. Styled with CSS modules and CSS variables (not Tailwind classes), Motion presets and reduced-motion support throughout.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @uiarc/<name>.
### snapcn — https://snapcn.dev
62 free MIT components for programmatic video — kinetic titles, captions, logo stings, device frames, cursor clicks, AI-chat input scenes and launch scenes, all rendered with Remotion.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @snapcn/<name>.
### beUI — https://beui.dev
122 free component pages — 59 Motion components, 24 blocks, 18 AI-agent pieces, 17 animated charts and 4 casino games. React 19, Tailwind v4, Motion 12.
License: MIT. Install: npx shadcn@latest add @beui/<name>.

### Chat & AI (chat)
- **Attachment** https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/attachment — Displays a file or image attachment with media, metadata, upload state, and actions. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **Bubble** https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/bubble — Displays conversational content in a message bubble. Supports variants, alignment, grouping, reactions, and collapsible content. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **Marker** https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/marker — Displays an inline status, system note, bordered row, or labeled separator in a conversation. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **Message** https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/message — Displays a message in a conversation, with optional avatar, header, footer, and alignment. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **Message Scroller** https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/message-scroller — A chat scroll container that anchors turns, opens saved transcripts, follows streamed responses, loads history without jumping, and jumps to any message. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **Prompt Library** https://cult-ui.com/docs/components/prompt-library — Browse, insert, and manage prompt templates with categories and custom prompts. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Instructions** https://cult-ui.com/docs/components/ai-instructions — Manage and toggle AI instructions with a popover, search, and create-dialog. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Input Selector** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-prompt — AI chat input with a model menu, a separate Effort control, file chips you can drop or paste, a / command menu, and Stop while replying. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Input Search** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-input-search — AI composer with a Tools menu (browse, investigate, draft, run code, reason), a model picker and a live trace that stacks each source's avatar as it is read. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI State Loading** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-loading — Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Text Loading** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-text-loading — AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Voice** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-voice — Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Tool Approval** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-tool-approval — Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Tool Calls** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-tool-calls — Tool calls inside a chat reply. Each call streams in as one row with a live timer, then they fold into a single line once the answer is ready. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Checkout** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-checkout — An order the assistant puts together, paid without leaving the chat. The button fills while the charge runs, then the card folds into a one-line receipt. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Connect** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-connect — A tool call that stops because an app is not connected. Connect it right in the message, and the call picks up where it stopped. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Send** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-send — An email the assistant drafted, editable in place. Send starts a short countdown you can undo before anything goes out. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Schedule** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-schedule — Meeting times the assistant found, each with a strip of both calendars so you can see why it is free. Booking folds the list into the event. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Attachment** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-attachment — A file dropped into the chat uploads, then the assistant reads it page by page. Page citations in the answer light up the page they point at. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Code Run** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-code-run — The assistant runs a short Python script in the reply. A marker steps down the lines, the output prints, and the chart it draws grows in. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Order Status** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-order-status — A live delivery card in the reply. The courier moves along the route while the ETA counts down, and the route turns green on arrival. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Handoff** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-handoff — The assistant hands the chat to a person, with what they will see so you don't repeat yourself. The queue counts down and the agent joins the thread. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Context Meter** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-context-meter — How full the context window is, as a ring in the prompt footer that opens a breakdown by source and compacts when it fills. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Inline Citations** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-citations — An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Diff Review** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-diff-review — A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Model Selector** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-model-selector — Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Token Alternatives** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-token-alternatives — An answer where every unsure word shows what else the model weighed. Pick another word and the reply writes itself again from there. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]

- **AI Inline Edit** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-inline-edit — Select text in a document and ask AI to rewrite it. The edit streams in place as a word-level diff you accept, discard or try again. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Message Queue** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-message-queue — Keep typing while the agent works. Follow-ups stack above the composer, where you can reorder, edit or send one now, and go in one by one when the run ends. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Redact** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-redact — Masks names, emails, card numbers and keys as placeholders before a prompt is sent, then fills the real values back into the reply. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Memory** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-memory — An assistant that saves what it learns about you into a memory list. New facts replace the ones they contradict, and you can edit or forget any of them. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]
- **AI Autocomplete** https://kokonutui.com/docs/ai/ai-autocomplete — A text box that suggests how your sentence ends in grey after the caret. Tab takes it all, the right arrow takes one word, and typing the same letters keeps it. [MIT, live-previewable, category: chat]

- **Astrix Dashboard** https://ui.watermelon.sh/dashboards — Analytics dashboard layout with sidebar and data cards. [Free, live-previewable, category: dashboards]
- **Jobtracker Dashboard** https://ui.watermelon.sh/dashboards — Job-application tracker dashboard — kanban lists, stats and status flows. [Free, live-previewable, category: dashboards]

### Login & Signup (auth)
- **Auth Blocks** https://ui.watermelon.sh/blocks/auth — 13 login/signup/auth layouts — split screens, centered cards, social-first. [Free, live-previewable, category: auth]
- **Sign up form** https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/signup-form — An account creation flow with field validation, password strength, and a clear completion state. [MIT, live-previewable, category: auth]
- **OTP input** https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/otp-input — A six digit verification flow with paste support and keyboard navigation. [MIT, live-previewable, category: auth]
- **Sign in** https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/sign-in — A sign in card that morphs from email to a six digit code to your account. [MIT, live-previewable, category: auth]
- **Centered login** https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/login-centered — A passkey-first login card on a quiet ring backdrop that morphs through email and code. [MIT, live-previewable, category: auth]
- **OTP Input** https://beui.dev/components/blocks/otp-input — One-time-code input with a gliding focus ring, digits that roll in per slot, error shake and a success check draw. [MIT, live-previewable, category: auth]
- **Sign Up Form** https://beui.dev/components/blocks/signup-form — Composed sign-up form that flags a field only once it is left, then clears the moment it is fixed, with a length-weighted strength meter, password reveal and an animated submit lifecycle. [MIT, live-previewable, category: auth]
